description: She wears a substantial opaque blue floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Muted gold geometric and floral woven trim borders neckline, sleeves, central front and hem. A cream patterned underdress shows through the lower central opening above brown closed footwear. An ivory shawl with blue woven borders drapes loosely around both forearms. A brown decorated belt carries several round gold-toned ornaments, and small earrings and a circular pendant provide restrained jewelry. The blue cloth appears wool-like and the pale layers linen-like; exact fibers are uncertain. No headgear or weapon appears.
